neighbours.label: a broken-byte token, a piece of a CJK character the tokenizer cannot keep whole (龜, 釀, 鑰, 纏), as opposed to the same text in simplified characters and to traditional characters that stay whole
fire: 他說釀酒需要耐心和時間。
我找不到家裡的鑰匙了。
今晚的籃球比賽開始了。
quiet: 他说酿酒需要耐心和时间。
我找不到家里的钥匙了。
今晚的足球比賽開始了。
